section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the Body Appreciation Scale (BAS), a 13-item instrument used to assess participants' body appreciation on a 5-point scale. The text reviews the BAS's psychometric properties from prior validation studies and notes that in the present study, Cronbach's alpha was .95, indicating strong internal consistency. No specific study numbers or multiple sample subsets are explicitly identified in this section.
